_comment: TDD M4 read slice: /v1/muse-code/models alias requires header auth (Bearer) like /v1/models. RED on baseline.
name: m4_read_api_v1_musecode_alias_auth
config:
[server]

api_keys = ["client-secret"]

[retry]

[[models]]
